title: Concept: Charset-less text/html or text/plain Content-Type
description: A text/html or text/plain response without a charset parameter leaves the decoding decision to the browser's fallback, so the same bytes can be interpreted under a different character mapping than the application intended. Declaring charset=utf-8 pins the mapping and removes the ambiguity.
risk: Encoding confusion that can turn inert bytes into script; MEDIUM severity.
